policy.label: policy
policy.deviation: D8: mens-by-default policy (exploratory) and the level-calibration check added after the uplift results were seen; the same X-learner is used for both emails
policy.learner_reason: X-learner visit scores for both emails: best and meaningfully above the baselines for the womens email; for the mens email no ranking beat random, so a 'best' mens learner chosen by its Qini coefficient would be selected on noise.
policy.carry_over_note: Scores were trained on visit; conversion and spend values measure how well a visit-based targeting carries over to those outcomes.

ab_winner.basis: both emails beat control on spend; larger estimated difference wins
